Assalamu wa rahmatullahi wa barakatu sisters, we hope this reaches you well it
Join us for our third annual hike on the lower Don Valley Trail next Saturday.
ROUTE: We will meet at the Big Park/Regent Park at 9:00 am, then walk towards Dundas and River to follow the B. We will then continue on the lower Don Valley trail, and continue to Evergreen Brickworks.
• Meet at 9:00 AM, depart at 9:30 AM sharp!
DON'T FORGET TO BRING WATER AND SNACKS!
We hope to see you all there!
For more information, DM us @habasisters
title: 🌲Don Valley Hike
